verdict.rationale: Docusign markets built-in AI chat and ready-to-deploy agents, so letting its AI consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only shows Docusign acting as an MCP server that external clients connect to (Claude, Gemini CLI). That server-side role does not count for this client-side story, and nothing shows Docusign itself plugging in third-party MCP servers.
